item.title: Grantham skatepark closed again to allow completion
item.description: An eagerly awaited £125,000 skatepark at Grantham’s Wyndham Park which was partially open to the public over the Christmas period, has been closed. item.description: Frozen ponds, lakes and rivers labelled dangerous and unpredictable.
